name: stript
description: Anonymize documents locally with Stript before their content enters the conversation, and restore AI answers on your own machine.
long_description: Stript detects personal data in documents on your machine and replaces it with consistent placeholders like [PERSON_1]. With this extension, Claude can ask Stript to anonymize a file before working with it, so the original content never enters the conversation. Restored answers are written to your clipboard or a local file and never appear in the chat. Requires the Stript desktop app with AI integrations enabled in Settings.

allowed_directories.title: Folders Stript may read documents from
allowed_directories.description: Claude can only anonymize files inside these folders. Keep the list as narrow as your workflow allows.

output_directory.title: Output folder
output_directory.description: Restored files and very large anonymized texts are written here.

enable_clipboard.title: Allow clipboard access
enable_clipboard.description: Adds a tool that anonymizes the text you copied. Claude asks before every clipboard read.

default_project.title: Stript project
default_project.description: Documents processed through Claude use this Stript project, which keeps placeholders consistent.

review_timeout_seconds.title: Review wait limit in seconds
review_timeout_seconds.description: How long a review request waits for you to finish in the Stript app before handing back a resumable status. Keep this below your chat client's own tool time limit.
